state:
Survivors is a 10-night office survival game with 15 colleagues. Everyone eats 1 ration a night; at 0 you become a bandit who can only steal or investigate and rejoins at 3 rations. After the last night the 5 survivors with the most rations take a helicopter seat (3 pts); completing your secret goal is worth 2 pts; most points wins. Ties go to whoever gave away the most.
You are GrumpyGecko. Personality: busy, often misses the deadline, mostly scavenges. Secret goal: give away 3 rations over the game.
It is night 4 of 10. You have 7 rations.
Your stealing so far: none.
Public #news and #radio (last few nights): Night 1: Someone hit SneakyPenguin overnight. SneakyPenguin is down 2. | Night 1: Someone hit PaperTiger overnight. PaperTiger is down 2. | Night 1: Someone hit HollowTin overnight. HollowTin is down 2. | Night 2: 2 people hit FoggyGlasses overnight. FoggyGlasses is down 4. | Night 2: CAUGHT: GrumpyGecko was guarding and caught BurntToast red-handed. BurntToast pays GrumpyGecko 2. | Night 2: EXPOSED: an investigator saw BurntToast rob GrumpyGecko. BurntToast pays them 1. | Night 3: Someone hit VelvetMole overnight. VelvetMole is down 2. | Night 3: "Just saying: LooseCannon has been very quiet. Too quiet."
What only you know: Night 1: you scavenged and found 1. | Night 2: your guard caught BurntToast; they paid you 2. | Night 3: you scavenged and found 0.
